summary: Configured a persistent, filesystem-enforced 100 MB XFS project quota for datauser under /srv/data. The operating-system release and kernel remain unchanged. Enforcement and restart persistence were verified.
actions_performed: Created datauser and /srv/data with datauser ownership and mode 0700.
Enabled XFS project quotas on the root filesystem using the existing kernel.
Mapped /srv/data to project srvdata (ID 20000) and applied 100M soft and hard limits.
Verified that 99 MiB succeeds and an additional 2 MiB fails at the 100M ceiling.
Restarted node1 and repeated health, quota, and enforcement checks successfully.

evidence.requirement: Filesystem-enforced 100 MB limit for datauser under /srv/data
evidence.summary: XFS project accounting and enforcement are ON; srvdata has 100M soft and hard limits; the boundary write test reached 100M and rejected further data.

evidence.requirement: Persistent configuration without changing the OS release or kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after configuration, node1 runs RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0. Persistent mount, project mapping, quota state, and data-path health were verified.

Healthy baseline boot ID fca6a729-6e3d-4ada-aca1-f47876b44b34 was captured, the safe restart was acknowledged, and boot ID changed to 395f8144-69e3-4065-9ebc-a7b0063f33c7. Post-restart system health, quota enforcement, account/path health, boundary behavior, and cleanup all passed.
